card.name: Dose unit mg after a number
card.fires_on: The unit mg right after a dose number in dosing instructions, as in 'start at 15 mg once daily'. Also fires on route words cut partway, like intraperitoneal and intramuscular.

modes.label: mg after dose number
modes.description: The unit mg directly after a starting or recommended dose amount, usually before 'once daily' or a route.
modes.example: The recommended dosage of RINVOQ is 15<< mg>> once daily.

modes.label: Partway through route words
modes.description: The end of an administration-route word such as intraperitoneal or intramuscular.
